exposure: hypothetical availability of alternative non-surgical, highly effective, and fully reversible male contraception
outcome: reasons for preferring alternative contraceptive methods
cohort: The study included 195 participants who had received vasectomies from Planned Parenthood North Central States since 2013 and were willing to be contacted for research purposes.
finding: A significant proportion (26.7%) of participants who had undergone a vasectomy reported that access to a different, highly effective, non-surgical, and fully reversible male contraceptive method would have likely or very likely changed their decision to have a vasectomy.
cross-section timing: Survey conducted with participants who had received vasectomies at various points since 2013, retrospectively assessing their preferences regarding contraceptive options available at the time of their vasectomy decision.
